summary.text: Joe Hannoush is the Libertarian candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 28, in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Republican incumbent Bill Partington and Democrat Sammy Jackson.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a "regular Joe American wanting less government" and said his priorities are lower taxes and less wasteful spending.

paragraphs.text: Hannoush has run as a Libertarian several times. He received 1.7% of the vote in the 2018 and 2.3% in 2020 general elections for Florida House District 25, both won by Republican Tom Leek.
In 2022 he was the Libertarian candidate for U.S. House in Florida's 6th Congressional District and received 24.7% of the vote against incumbent Michael Waltz.
In 2024 he ran for Florida House District 28 and received 2.3% of the vote, behind Republican Bill Partington and Democrat John Navarra.
Ballotpedia says he signed the U.S. Term Limits Pledge.
In his 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Hannoush gave his key messages as less government on all issues and protection of all rights at all times.
He said the core responsibility of the office is to adhere to the oath to uphold the Constitution, and he named flooding and insurance as the state's greatest challenge over the next decade.
